_README: Edit these answers anytime — they power the 'Have a question?' popup (and, later, the chat assistant's knowledge base). Keep them accurate to your policy.

faqs.q: How fast can I move in?
faqs.a: Most rooms are next-day move-in once you're approved, and approval is usually quick. Pick a room, apply, and you can often move in the same or next day.

faqs.q: What does it cost to move in?
faqs.a: Just a $19 application fee to apply — and it's refunded if you're not approved. Once you're approved, your first week's rent is due to move in. There's no big security deposit.

faqs.q: How does payment work / when is rent due?
faqs.a: Rent is paid weekly, in advance. Your first week is due when you move in, and after that you're billed automatically on the same weekday each week — utilities and WiFi are already included, so there are no separate bills.

Rent is billed weekly, in advance — that's how our billing works, so there isn't a monthly option. Your first week is due when you move in, and after that you're charged automatically on the same weekday each week. If weekly doesn't fit your schedule, you can ask us about paying bi-weekly instead.

faqs.q: What do I need to get approved?
faqs.a: You'll need income of at least 2x the rent, and no felonies, violent misdemeanors, or evictions in the past 7 years. PadSplit runs the background screening automatically during your application.

faqs.q: Can I tour a home before booking?
faqs.a: You can explore every room and common area through the photos and 3D tour on each listing. If you'd like more detail on a specific home, just text us.

faqs.q: Can two people share a room?
faqs.a: Most rooms are single-occupancy. Some homes allow double occupancy for an additional fee — you can search for rooms that allow double occupancy here. (Bringing a child? Text us about a specific home and we'll confirm.)
No, our homes are pet-free. To find a home for you and your furry friend, search here. (Registered service animals are handled separately — text us if that applies to you.)
No long lease. You pay weekly and can stay as long as you like — most residents stay 6–12 months.
Your furnished room, all utilities, WiFi, and shared common areas — one weekly payment, no separate bills.
Every resident is background-checked, and each room has its own electronic door lock for privacy and security.
